title: VTC Vetting — Revocations — List — payload
description: An administrator pages through the vetting-statement withdrawal notices the community has recorded, each with the admissions it touches. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`.

limit.description: Page size. The community chooses when absent (50 in the reference implementation).

ReviewState.title: ReviewState
ReviewState.description: Whether a withdrawn statement touches a standing membership. `noAdmission`: no current member was admitted with the statement counted. `needsReview`: a current member was — their admission rested on evidence its vetter has taken back. A signal for an administrator, not a workflow: nothing records that one looked.

RevocationNotice.title: RevocationNotice
RevocationNotice.description: One withdrawal notice, as vtc/vetting/revoke-statement recorded it, and the admissions it touches.

issuer.description: The vetter who withdrew the statement.

reason.description: The vetter's reason, when given, as vtc/vetting/revoke-statement defines it.

recordedAt.description: When the community recorded the notice.

affectedJoinRequests.description: Approved join requests whose recorded vetting facts counted the statement.

affectedMembers.description: Of those requests' applicants, the ones who are current members.

Response.title: VTC Vetting — Revocations — List — response payload

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain; pass it as `cursor`.
